response.sql:
WITH state_accounts AS (
  SELECT 
    c.state_county_province,
    COUNT(a.account_id) as account_count
  FROM Customers c
  LEFT JOIN Accounts a ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id
  GROUP BY c.state_county_province
),
with_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    state_county_province,
    account_count,
    CAST(account_count AS DECIMAL(19,4)) / SUM(account_count) OVER () as share
  FROM state_accounts
),
with_avg_share AS (
  SELECT 
    state_county_province,
    account_count,
    share,
    AVG(share) OVER () as avg_share
  FROM with_shares
)
SELECT 
  SUM(account_count) as combined_account_base,
  AVG(share) as average_share,
  AVG(share - avg_share) as avg_distance_above_average
FROM with_avg_share
WHERE share > avg_share

assumptions.assumption: "Account base" refers to the count of account records in the Accounts table for customers in each state, not the count of distinct customers per state.
